price.weights_note: The AVM sits lower because it can't see your pool, third bathroom or 2014 build quality, so it carries the least weight. The range runs from 3% below to 5% above the weighted value, to allow for condition and presentation, which we confirm at inspection.

price.why_heading: Why the guide sits below the range
price.why:
Bulimba buyers are active but price-sensitive. Four of the six competing homes have passed a deadline or auction unsold, and days on market rose to 44 in the September quarter. A guide of offers over $2.50m puts your home in front of every buyer searching from $2.5m, and lets competition carry the price into the range.

Your reserve and sale method are your call. We'll talk both through with you.
